title: Run Validity
description: Run-validity state machine. A run transitions through validity states as required records and invariants are evaluated. Defined in docs/observability.md 'Health and run validity'. Telemetry-export failure alone produces degraded observability, not an invalid experiment, provided the authoritative record remains intact.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run whose validity is being recorded.

previous_validity.description: Prior validity state before this transition (absent for the initial evaluation).

transition_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the validity transition.

evaluated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the validity was evaluated.

evaluator_component.description: Component that performed the validity evaluation.

evidence_summary.description: Summary of evidence supporting this validity state.

invalidating_event_ids.description: Identifiers of domain events that caused this validity state, when applicable.

version.description: Schema version of the run-validity record format.

examples.evidence_summary: All required domain events and invariants are intact.
